But you're naive if you think solving problems is as simple as "facing our combined strength inward," as if holding hands and singing kumbaya would reconcile opposing views. The RIGHT solutions to problems are actually pretty cheap, no 'combined strength' required - the difficulty is deciding WHICH solution to attempt first. Political tension exists (and has always existed) for two reasons alone: we have competing solutions to existing problems, and we prioritize those problems differently. That is literally 100% of political conflict. This video does nothing but paint every solution and every priority with the same shit brush, as if everyone is wrong and dumb and assholes. But that's false. Some ideas are right, and others are wrong. And the way you prove that your cause is just is by arguing with the support of facts and truth.
